note: Refusal surface for T01 and T05. The gate calibration had no out_of_scope rows for either tenant, so their confidence gates could only be assessed on false refusals — nothing tested whether they would wrongly answer an unanswerable question. These rows fix that.
label_basis: agent, single pass. Each row names a topic and the topic was searched for across the tenant corpus; a row was only labelled out_of_scope after the search came back empty. Not owner validation.
scope_note: Per KNOWN_ISSUES §11, out_of_scope is TENANT-SCOPED. A row marked out_of_scope for T01 may be answerable for T04 or T05, and that does not make the label wrong. Rows below are out_of_scope for the named tenant; several are out of scope for the whole fleet, which is noted where it applies.
